description: This file contains the implementation of a parser for the JMESPath query language, including token processing, expression parsing, and syntax error handling.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A Pratt parser for interpreting JMESPath expressions, converting them into an abstract syntax tree (AST).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a JMESPath expression string into an AST, throwing syntax errors on failure.

methods.name: expr
methods.description: Parses sub-expressions based on right binding power, implementing Pratt parsing logic.

methods.name: syntax
methods.description: Generates a syntax error exception with a message and current token context.
